claims.notes: Support claim reopened by the 2026-08-08 installed-package audit. Layout detection works; BGA-124 restored the state half and BGA-125 the action half: documented state-class initial states, StateConstants identifiers, PRIVATE states, descriptions, zombie handling, class/id/transition redirects, #[PossibleAction] entry points, framework-injected parameters, the game-class fallback and the parameter attributes are all read, and an unreadable construct is reported rather than turned into a certain finding. BGA-126 added the notification half: the state-class shortcut is read, a notif_ method counts only where setupPromiseNotifications registers it, and the framework's predefined types need no handler. Unrelated SQL-like strings (BGA-127) and the complete packaged matrix (BGA-128) still own the rest of this claim.

BGA-124 corrected the class half and the GameStateBuilder half the hybrid fixture now uses, and BGA-125 the action half; BGA-126 the notification half; BGA-127 and BGA-128 own the rest of this claim.
